name: Zephon
role: TFAH literary character (Milton's Paradise Lost) -- Gabriel's officer, partnered with Ithuriel.
description: TFAH literary character. Category B/D: the name belongs to a human in the Bible (a son of Eliphaz, Esau's grandson), not an angel -- its use as an angel-name traces to Isaac ha-Cohen of Soria's 16th-century kabbalistic 'Treatise on the Left Emanation.' See docs/milton/character-catalog.md §V.
narrative_function: Accompanies Ithuriel; escorts Satan before Gabriel.
